answer: Start from linguistic fingerprint proof. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. One honest agent clears the check in 14 minutes; a farm of 729 pays 10206 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The harbor sits in the mechanism itself, the ivory sits in the price of faking it, and the violet sits in the record no template can forge. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
